verification_route: Supplied macro executed in an isolated Fiji installation through the local ImageJ script interface. Only the macro-file location and output-folder selection were supplied automatically.
timing_scope: Automated macro execution including TIFF loading, bidirectional analysis, CSV output and small local script-interface overhead; excludes installation, Fiji startup and manual folder selection.
installation_time: Planning estimate: 1–5 minutes with Fiji installed, or 5–15 minutes including Fiji; not a measured fresh-install benchmark.
validation: Both summary rows and all eight object rows match known answers, including volumes, XYZ centroids, coincidence flags, partner labels and contains counts.
